reviews.x: This is the absolute best white eyeshadow! If you want something that’s a matte white, no shimmer, no sparkle but a lot of pigment ( color) this is the one for you!

reviews.t: great matte, white shadow for a good price
reviews.x: great matte, white shadow for a good price. its so hard to find a white that doesnt have any shimmer in it, but i have finally done it. good pigmentation, and blends fairly easily.  a bit chalky but what can you expect for a matte shadow.  I like to use this (sparingly) as a highlight on my browbone, cheekbones, and inner corner of the eye. Because I am pretty pale, the only thing that isn't too dark for my highlight is pure white.

I am happy to have found this. I have used it in the past but wasn't able to find it until now. The whipped cream Creme color looks white in the container but when I apply it to my eyelid it has just a hint of light gray. Best off all, this formula covers the fine lines in my eyelids, goes on very smoothly, and lasts better than others I have tried.

Besides MAC this is the best matte white shadow out there- and the price is 1/4 of theirs.  It stays on long and there's such a bright pigment - JUST buy it- trust me I have tried every one out there.

Omg! I cannot say enough about NYX shadow! This white base color is amazing! I am very fair skinned and finding a great base shadow that stands out has been difficult to find. This stuff is better than some $20+ eyeshadows I have purchased. I have become a BIG fan of this make-up line because its super inexpensive & is top quality! Their matte lipsticks have changed my life!!!

reviews.t: would likely buy a better brand because it is not extremely dark
reviews.x: Use this as a base coat for coloring and for mixing my own colors. If you wanted it for strictly white coloring, would likely buy a better brand because it is not extremely dark.

I do not use this as eye shadow - I use it to cover thin areas in my white hair.  I brush a little where the hair is thin, and it disguises the thinning. So I cannot on how it works as an eye shadow but for thinning hair, it is wonderful!!  And, Ladies, before my hair turned all white I used grey eye shadow to disguise thin areas and just bought grey shadow for a young man  I know who has areas of alopecia.

Highly pigmented!! I use an eyeshadow primer under it, and have great results! It makes the other colors pop, or looks great by itself! Super-bright white, exactly as I wanted. Very happy with this product and am looking at other colors!

reviews.t: Matte white works great for eyeshadow and bass
reviews.x: This is an awesome Matt White I use for bass and for eyeshadow color stays on great

I haven't been able to find a white eyeshadow that doesn't have some kind of glitter in it. I wanted some that is just white with no sparkle or glitter. This eyeshadow certainly fits the bill!!! Just what I was looking for!!! I bought it because of the reviews, & it certainly didn't disappoint!!! I am so happy with it, I'm going to see how long it takes me to use it, & then I will start having it delivered thru subscribe & save. I highly recommend this eyeshadow!!!
I use this for my inner corner, with just about every look. It’s creamy, pigmented & just enough pop to get the point across. Perfect!!!
Eh...this is alright...doesn't last very long, especially during the summer.  I would recommend a better brand for staying power.
Some lesser brands don’t go on smoothly or stay on very long, I love NYX brand!

I went to ulta beauty to buy more and that lady told me they completely stopped making the single pallet of white. I was so sad. Come to find out they didn't. When I came across this I was so happy. Might seem a little expensive for 1 tiny thing of it but all make up is expensive.  This is definitely worth it if u

reviews.t: Great matte white for highlighting without shine! Natural look...
reviews.x: Love this white and use it all the time on my lids, eyebrow arch and even to contour under my eyes to look awake.  Best part is there is no glitter to add to my wrinkles, only a clean white pigment to highlight my look.  It's rather small and I hope it is deeper so it lasts a while or else I need to buy one more for back-up.

The only white eyeshadow I'll ever buy again! Super pigmented and perfect for brightening the inner corners. The ONLY reason it's 4 stars and not 5 is cause the packaging is really cheap. The clear window part popped off inside the mailer and I had to super glue it back on but it hasn't been a problem since
You can’t find a nice matte white eye shadow in the stores without paying a lot of money so this one works for me! It goes on smoothly and bends beautifully. Would purchase again.
This eyeshadow was perfectly pigmented for my Halloween skull makeup!  Great value and very pigmented.  I used this to set and highlight over Ben Nye Clown White base.
A perfect matte white. Love this eye shadow. Stays on long. I always get compliments on my makeup.
Just what I wanted. No shimmer and goes well on the skin

reviews.x: Great product.  Close to my Lancome Daylight shadow.

I ordered 6 brands of white eye shadow.  All needed to be returned except this one.  Some were too glittery, iridescent or bright white.  This is a matte finish and I use it under my brow or inner corner of my eye.

reviews.t: perfect color for fair skin & gray hair
reviews.x: This shadow is perfect for highlighting under brows and the corner of eyes. I haven't been able to find a white in years, they are all on the yellow side.  This is perfect. Stays on well, blends well, good price.
This is a true white. Another win for NYX. They really are an excellent drugstore brand makeup. Great for a striking matte white center/corner lid. Full of pigment. Happy i found it!

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the strong pigmentation and bright white color of this matte eyeshadow.
Many customers value that it is a true matte white with no shimmer or glitter.
Several reviewers highlight its good value and quality relative to pricier brands.
A few reviewers note it can be chalky or not long-lasting, especially in summer.
Some customers use it as a base or highlighter for other looks and colors.
